title: Pemulwuy
summary: Pemulwuy was a Bidjigal (Bediagal) man from the Botany Bay and Georges River country who led guerrilla raids on settler farms in early Sydney through the 1790s, including at Parramatta and Toongabbie. He survived being wounded at Parramatta in 1797 and was shot dead on 2 June 1802; who killed him is uncertain.

uncertainty.note: Birth is given as "around 1750" by the City of Parramatta; death is 2 June 1802 in both sources.

where.modern_name: Botany Bay and Georges River, Sydney, Australia

importance.justification: A leader of armed Aboriginal resistance to the British colony at Sydney in the 1790s.

audience_note: Concerns frontier violence and a killing; stated in general terms.
